title: Chain-level relative comparison presentation on a compact source-open union
statement: Let f:X→S, f′:X′→S′, g:S′→S, g′:X′→X form a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with S,S′ affine and f quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let K and K′ have quasi-coherent derived cohomology [def-pc-derived-category], and φ:L(g′)*K→K′ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Let U,V be compact opens of X with compact intersection. For each open Z let a_Z be the canonical comparison arrow [def-pc-single-complex-open-comparison]. There exist short complexes P,P′ of cochain complexes of O_S′-modules, a morphism m:P→P′, and six isomorphisms e_i:Q(P_i)≅A_i, e_i′:Q(P_i′)≅B_i, where (A₁,A₂,A₃)=(domain a_(U∪V), domain a_U⊕domain a_V, domain a_(U∩V)) and (B₁,B₂,B₃) are the corresponding codomains. Both P and P′ are short exact. The localized components satisfy Q(m₁)e₁′=e₁ a_(U∪V), Q(m₂)e₂′=e₂(a_U⊕a_V), and Q(m₃)e₃′=e₃ a_(U∩V). This statement asserts no connecting morphism, distinguished triangle or triangle morphism.

source.place: Tags 08HZ, 08HY and 0DJ9, relative restriction sequence and coefficient comparison before passing to the derived triangle; functorial cylinder replacement as in Tags 013N and 013O. Online 08HZ, 08HY, 0DJ9 read on 2026-10-14.

proof.text: Obtain strict first-map squares, six localized vertex comparisons and all three component conjugacy equations from compatible chain models.

Apply the explicit compatible cylinder construction to this strict square and its three equations. It constructs short exact rows and transports all three components, giving exactly the original existential presentation.

proof_origin.place: Compatible chain models followed by explicit functorial cylinder, replacing the invalid arbitrary-row compatibility inference.

mathlib_searches.query: A short exact complex model for the relative Mayer Vietoris base change diagram on a union of open subschemes
A morphism of short exact sequences of complexes gives a morphism of distinguished triangles in the derived category
mathlib_searches.results: triangleOfSES, triangleOfSESδ and triangleOfSES_distinguished; these supply the subsequent triangle construction, not geometric short exact representatives with the three pinned comparison components.
Found boundary naturality once a short exact complex diagram is supplied.

Mathlib ShortExact provides triangle functoriality. DerivedOpenUnionSESPresentation gives one coefficient over X, not the base-pullback comparison. RelativeMVSESPresentation requires a global cover and importing it closes a cycle through the parent. No usable exact statement for the arbitrary union.

lean.statement:
theorem singleComplexOpenComparison_union_ses_presentation
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S']
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X K)
    (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X') (hK' : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X' K')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (U V : X.Opens)
    (hUqc : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hVqc : IsCompact (V : Set X))
    (hUVqc : IsCompact ((U ⊓ V : X.Opens) : Set X)) :
    let a : X.Opens → Arrow (schemeDerivedCategory S') := fun Z ↦
      Arrow.mk (singleComplexOpenComparison f f' g g' sq.w K K' φ Z)
    ∃ (P P' : ShortComplex (CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace)) ℤ))
      (m : P ⟶ P')
      (e₁ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₁ ≅ (a (U ⊔ V)).left)
      (e₂ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₂ ≅ (a U).left ⊞ (a V).left)
      (e₃ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₃ ≅ (a (U ⊓ V)).left)
      (e₁' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₁ ≅ (a (U ⊔ V)).right)
      (e₂' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₂ ≅ (a U).right ⊞ (a V).right)
      (e₃' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₃ ≅ (a (U ⊓ V)).right),
      P.ShortExact ∧ P'.ShortExact ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₁ ≫ e₁'.hom = e₁.hom ≫ (a (U ⊔ V)).hom ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₂ ≫ e₂'.hom =
        e₂.hom ≫ biprod.map (a U).hom (a V).hom ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₃ ≫ e₃'.hom = e₃.hom ≫ (a (U ⊓ V)).hom
